Apple TV could be getting a golf championship Sports rights have become a battleground as streamers seek to take over from legacy media. Apple has had small successes in getting rights for MLS , MLB , and F1 , but its ambitions go much further. According to a report from The Guardian , Apple TV is in early discussions with the R&A about streaming rights for golf's Open Championship. articles.title: iOS 27 celebrates your friends' birthdays with fireworks
articles.description: New in iOS 27 is a birthday reminder that means if you are on a call with someone, your iPhone will tell you if it's their special day with fireworks! The gift is still on you, though. Whether you remember to call them, or they passive-aggressively call you, iOS 27 will make sure you know it's their birthday. There may not be a smaller addition to iOS 27 , but the Phone app's birthday reminder is a really nice touch. In the current betas , if you call someone, the Phone app checks the contact card you've got for them. It does exactly the same if they call you, and it always has, as that's how it displays their name and probably a contact photo. But now it does one more thing. On This Day in Space: NASA launched the 100-foot Echo 1A balloon on August 12, 1960; the passive satellite reflected telephone, radio and television signals across Earth
articles.description: On August 12, 1960, NASA launched Echo 1A, a 100-foot balloon that became its first successful communications satellite. The passive spacecraft reflected telephone, radio and television signals between distant points on Earth. It also helped NASA study atmospheric density, solar pressure and satellite triangulation before re-entering Earth’s atmosphere in 1968.
